caption: The drawing depicts a single upright mechanical object placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object is cylindrical and metallic in appearance, rendered in shades of gray and black. At the top, the cylinder is capped by four upward-curving, petal-like extensions, shaped like rounded blades or lobes. The main cylindrical body is vertically oriented and smooth, with two visible flat face panels. At the base, the object widens slightly to a circular platform, and an additional, smaller vertical cylinder is positioned on this platform in front of the main body. The rendering uses subtle shading to indicate three-dimensionality and reflectivity of the surfaces. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
title: Sconce
